rules.entry: Donchian 20 breakout at completed close; enter next session open
rules.stop: Initial stop at entry minus 2 x ATR(14) from signal close; daily low checked; adverse gap exits at open
rules.LEVA_LONG: Exit at close of third holding session
rules.MATERIE_PRIME_LEVA: Exit next open after two consecutive completed closes with Walking upper Bollinger Band false; hard cap at close of session 10 (never held into session 11)
rules.walking: Commodity entries require Walking true on the same completed close (at least 2 of last 3 qualifying Bollinger sessions); exits after 2 consecutive false closes at next open
rules.position_limit: One open position per ticker; no overlapping entries
rules.activation: First run establishes a baseline on the latest available daily candle; it does not backfill or fabricate historical trades.
